command_display:
bash -lc '
set -euo pipefail
range=d33c62eebc48de5e8a65c50e057addf25f125c6b..51e7faddad943ab7727e407d008e474ec076566d
printf "added_comment_lines_by_file_top25\n"
git diff --unified=0 "$range" -- "*.cpp" "*.cppm" "*.hpp" "*.h" |
awk '"'"'
/^\+\+\+ b\// { file=substr($0,7); next }
/^\+[^+]/ {
  line=substr($0,2)
  if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*(\/\/\/|\/\/|\/\*|\*|#)/) print file
}
'"'"' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | sed -n "1,25p"
printf "representative_added_comment_lines\n"
git diff --unified=0 "$range" -- "*.cpp" "*.cppm" "*.hpp" "*.h" |
awk '"'"'
/^\+\+\+ b\// { file=substr($0,7); next }
/^\+[^+]/ {
  line=substr($0,2)
  if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*(\/\/\/|\/\/|\/\*|\*|#)/) print file "\t" line
}
'"'"' | sed -n "1,160p"
'
label: agent-window-added-comment-sample
